original_generation_prompt:
Use case: compositing, ads-marketing.
Asset: a revised Steam main cover illustration for the existing Water Margin RTS game.
Input image 1 is the edit target: preserve its Chinese ink-and-gouache painting, aged ivory paper, ink-black title field, muted lake teal, antique gold, mountainous Liangshan water fortress, soldiers and overall landscape composition.
Primary change requested by the user: the cover needs a BEAUTIFUL WOMAN as the unmistakable leading figure.
Replace the dominant foreground male commander with Hu Sanniang, a fictional ADULT Chinese woman warrior in her mid-to-late twenties. Make her strikingly beautiful and immediately readable at small cover size: refined oval face, expressive dark eyes, graceful brows, warm natural skin, elegant black hair tied up with a small red ribbon, confident calm gaze and a slight assured smile. Her face must be large, unobscured and carefully painted. She is an attractive commanding heroine, not a generic armored man with a feminine face.
She fills the right-center foreground in a three-quarter waist-up view, wearing an elegant ivory Song-inspired robe with restrained crimson accents and fitted practical dark lamellar shoulder/waist armor, tasteful feminine silhouette, fully clothed. One hand rests on the hilt of a period dao; keep hands anatomically convincing and weapons plausible. A little wind in her hair and ribbon.
Keep Lin Chong and a compact group of spear-and-shield Liangshan troops as SMALLER supporting figures behind her to make this read as a strategy game about commanding forces. The adult woman is clearly the star; men must not compete with her face. Retain the lake, water fortress gate and plain faded red flag from the reference in the background.
Keep the left approximately 43 percent as dark ink negative space with the same large antique-ivory brush title, clearly legible and correctly spelled. Exact title in two lines: 水浒 then 英雄传. Exact smaller warm gold subtitle below: 八幕战役. These are the ONLY words.
Preserve safe title margins and edge-to-edge painterly artwork. Recompose gracefully within the reference's wide 1232:706 aspect ratio; target 1232 by 706 pixels or a higher resolution at that same shape.
No modern makeup styling, no glossy photorealistic mobile-game look, no anime, no fantasy bikini armor, no extra text, no logos or watermark, no collage or border. Render the actual finished cover artwork, not a mockup.
main_processing: The user attachment is preserved byte for byte. Main capsule only conforms dimensions with FFmpeg Lanczos 1657x949 -> 1232x706; no crop, repaint, mirror or text replacement.
variant_processing: Other aspect ratios are generated layout adaptations, not pixel-identical crops.

root_visual_review.observations: Official title and subtitle complete; foreground adult woman matches approved direction; male characters remain behind her. Header and small keep readable title and recognizable face. Hero has no text and its left area allows the retained library logo.
